Fundamental Analysis







 Gold prices pulled back amid rising US Treasury yields and a stronger US dollar, as the escalating Middle East conflict stoked inflation fears and cooled expectations of a Fed rate cut.​
 


 Safe-haven demand initially supported bullion, but inflation concerns from surging oil prices outweighed the geopolitical premium, with markets now pricing less of Fed cuts in 2026.
 


 Gold prices could find renewed support ahead, with US Feb NFP potentially serving as key catalysts for the next directional move.​

 Gold hovers around EMA21 and the support at 5060. The price is at a break-or-make level, which may determine the short-term movement ahead.
 


 If XAUUSD breaches below the support at 5060, the price may sink toward EMA78.
 


 Alternatively, remaining above the support at 5060 and EMA21 may prompt a retest of the immediate resistance at 5550.
